summary: v2.2 team logo linking: schedule.team_id feature tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 4 pytest cases pass; UI flows for /schedule/new team chips, schedule tab card display, athletes tab cards, athlete detail header, and competition detail (Our Teams Attending + Performance Schedule) all render TeamAvatar correctly (colored-dot fallback since uploaded test teams have no logo_image, which is expected per agent_to_agent_context_note). No crashes. No deprecated package issues introduced.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: when navigating directly to /schedule/new and saving, router.back() emits a dev-only warning 'GO_BACK was not handled by any navigator' because there is no prior route. Non-blocking and only triggered by deep-link navigation in testing, not normal user flow (users reach the screen via push from the Schedule tab). Optional: replace router.back() with router.replace('/schedule') as a safer fallback.
ScheduleEventUpdate.team_id is correctly included in the nullable set in routers/schedule.py so PATCH can clear it to null — verified by test_patch_clear_team_id_to_null.
seed_data_creation: Created one schedule event via UI testing (TEST_UI_event_with_team) and deleted it during teardown. All backend pytest cases also cleaned up via fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two teams already exist on the apple-review account (Senior Elite Coed 5, Youth Level 2). Neither has logo_image set, so TeamAvatar correctly shows the colored-dot fallback in every place — this is expected, not a bug. To verify the actual <Image> branch of TeamAvatar, PATCH a small base64 data URI into /api/teams/{id} logo_image and re-check schedule rows / athletes cards / athlete detail header / competition chips & performance schedule headers.
